discovery_notes: Follow-up 8 of B005 (packets 205, 409, 454, 487, 511, 532, 552, 570). 29 standard searches, snippets/summaries only. New pins: 24 Aug LE 250 Sorcerer Mickey + Tinker Bell 19.99 Pueblo (dein-dlrp line items); Aug World's Best Friends Chip & Chap and carrousel Snow White LE 700 15.99 Pueblo (dein-dlrp; DPB/forum corroborate Snow White); Stitch Phantom Manor OE 9.99 5 Jan 2019 (Phantom Manor Legends quoted); CM Exclusive Dalmatien Noël 3019 re-issue Q1 2019 (passiondlp); Christmas Time Event Series Snow White/Dwarfs/Old Hag (MyPinCentral). Release evidence: 3 Aug Christmas singles four (quoted dein-dlrp line items). RVG: one-pin claims per pair to clear the pin-structure conflict. Lion King jumbo placed in Les Trésors de Disneyland Paris by official Disney Store EU listing. Still open: Phantom Manor doom-buggy pins, other Christmas Time pins, 5 Jan LE designs, PTN Feb/Apr sizes, Marvel price, dein-dlrp Jan/May/Oct.
